had often played to them . . . which begin[s] “Allah Malla punca” ’ (Iris Origo, The Last

Mary will ‘send you the Indian air’, very likely the one including the refrain Tazee be tazee
no be no that Medwin recalled as that to which I arise from dreams of thee was set (L ii 403).
